Macrons

Consonantal i

Town, shops & places

hairdresser noun

also hair stylist

classical

Traupman 167, 325

1tōnstrīx: long o (Lewis & Short leaves it unmarked). Marked long by the hidden-quantity rule before -ns-. Ruling: Macrons are spelling.

tōnstrīx1, tōnstrīcis f.

noun, third declension

Morgan–Owens gives tōnsor, tōnstrīx and capillōrum concinnātor (M-O s.v. barber, citing Col.). Classically tōnstrīx is a woman barber (Plaut.).

Other words

  • ōrnātrīx, ōrnātrīcis f.

    noun, third declension · also used · classical · Traupman 167, 325

    Classically a lady’s maid who dressed her hair (Ov.).

See also barber, barber’s shop, haircut.

SourcesLewis & Short: tonstrix · Lewis & Short: ornatrix
